name: MediaEmbed
summary: A third-party video page (YouTube, Vimeo) inside the Aurea frame, loaded only when asked for.

a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 2026-09-24 (apps/keyboard-probe + tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts). Confirmed: Enter, Space — both swap the facade for the frame and move focus into it. The facade is a native <button>, so there is no engine keyboard; once the frame loads, the keyboard belongs to the provider's page, which this library cannot measure.

props.name: src
props.description: The provider's EMBED address, e.g. https://www.youtube.com/embed/<id>. Any other <iframe> attribute is accepted and forwarded, and wins over the defaults.

props.name: title
props.description: Required. The accessible name of the frame — an unnamed iframe fails axe, so the type refuses to compile without it.

props.name: poster
props.description: Still image for the facade. With it, nothing from the provider loads until the play button is pressed; without it, the frame loads lazily right away.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Box proportion in CSS syntax. Reserved before anything loads, so the page does not jump.

props.name: href
props.description: The video on its own site. Shown as a link under the frame — the way out when the owner blocks embedding, which the page cannot detect.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: With a poster, start playing after the click by adding autoplay=1 to the address (YouTube and Vimeo read the same key). The person already asked to play.
